job_spec.name: qkd_seq_core-kc2-dbf8a21da
job_spec.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 track B (one die type): control leaf of the merged-die KV sequencer cluster qkd_seq (new RTL: the KV sequencer + the ROM-end x3 buffer without the D2D adapters + the die's stage stepper ot_qfd_dctl on the ROM sequencer's raw pins). Every pin a register, own root: N = ROM side (x3 valid / tag / credit, r_sd 56 status levels, kvd launcher, RES to the VM under 64 reserved credits, t_ds 187 stage-step + write words, program write copy t_pw), S = hub RES / host step + result levels / fault word, W / E = fan control (own copies), N = store control. M5 leaf, recipe 2.
